body:
Hi @brandonroberts ,

Should i update this from npm.
As a workaround, replace the GitHub URL with `^0.8.0` in the `package.json`. I have a fix for the `package.json` generator for the zip files.

Hi @kapunahelewong ,
I think this is still using githib link, should i update it.

What Brandon suggested above is that switching to `^0.8.0` locally is fine. Switching it in the angular repo, however, might make some tests fail on CI.

I don't know if that current version of `angular-in-memory-web-api` (0.9.0) is sufficient to make CI happy, but we can definitely try that. @santoshyadav198613, feel free to submit a PR updating to the latest version to check CI.

issue.title: docs: update in-memory-we-api version
